name: search_files
description: Search file contents for a pattern (a regular expression; literal:true for plain text). Gives path:line:text, sorted. Files git ignores are left out. Paths are shown escaped (\n, \t, \\ and \xNN for other control or non-UTF-8 bytes), and control characters of a line as \xNN. Example: {"pattern":"fn main","include":"*.rs"}

pattern.description: Regular expression (`(?i)` ignores case), or plain text with `literal`

path.description: Directory (or file) to search, relative to the worktree root; leave out for all of it

include.description: Glob the file paths must match, e.g. `*.rs`

literal.description: Take the pattern as plain text, not a regular expression

repo.description: The slot to search in; leave out when there is one
